meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: Claude 会写小段浏览器脚本操作网页,每段只做一件事,并在多次运行之间保留页面状态;可导航网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试网页。
howto.when: 当你提出访问网站、填表、截图、抓取数据或测试网页等浏览器操作时接管,例如说出 “go to [url]”、“click on”、“take a screenshot” 等。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截个图给我看看
say.note: 新建名为 example 的页面并截图

say.text: 登录我 Chrome 里已有的账号,去后台改下设置
say.note: 需先启动扩展模式并连接扩展

say.text: 把 Hacker News 首页的文章标题抓下来
say.note: 用 ARIA 快照定位元素后读取

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude writes small browser-automation scripts that each do one action and keep page state between runs: navigating, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots, scraping data, and testing web pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to navigate a site, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, or test a web app — e.g. "go to [url]", "click on", "take a screenshot".

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot for me
say_en.note: Creates an "example" page and screenshots it

say_en.text: Log into my existing Chrome account and change a setting
say_en.note: Requires extension mode to be connected first

say_en.text: Scrape the article titles from the Hacker News homepage
say_en.note: Uses the ARIA snapshot to find elements
